description: Before pasting a log, a HAR file or any text into a ticket, chat or prompt: find the secrets and personal data in it (API keys, JWTs, session cookies, Authorization headers, passwords, cards, emails…). A HAR is read entry by entry, so each finding says in which request, header, cookie, query parameter or body it sits — the way the 2023 Okta support breach happened, through a HAR with live session tokens. Returns a short preview per finding (never the full secret) and `redacted`: the same content with every finding replaced, ready to paste.

content.description: The text or HAR (JSON) to check

name: paste_check
